## What is Roboflow Rapid?

Training a custom vision model usually means collecting data, labeling it, choosing hyperparameters, and waiting for training to finish. [Roboflow Rapid](https://rapid.roboflow.com/) compresses that loop into minutes: you upload images, annotate what you want the model to find, and Rapid trains a detector for you.

Rapid is the fastest way to answer a practical question: **"Can a model learn to recognize *my* objects?"** The result is a model you can test in the browser and deploy as an API — no local GPU required.

## Your Task

**Goal:** Use Roboflow Rapid to train a small custom object detector on images you provide, then test it on a new image.

Open the tutorial: [rapid.roboflow.com/yolotutorial](https://rapid.roboflow.com/yolotutorial)
